item.ptxt: The rearview camera is a precision device. Failure to take the following precautions may cause a malfunction or fire.
Do not use high pressure water or hot water of more than 80 °C (176 °F) around the camera.
Do not remove snow or mud on the lens with a sharp objects or an item that may scratch the lens.
The lens of rearview camera is hard coated to prevent damage or discoloration. Failure to take the following precautions may cause damage or discoloration of lens and obscure the image.
Do not use a brush to clean. Use a sponge or soft cloth.
Do not apply chemicals such as alcohol, benzene or thinner.
Do not apply wax coating. If the wax gets on the lens, wipe off the wax with a clean cloth dampened with diluted detergent with water, then wipe with a dry cloth.
